title: Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme's Improvements for Residents in Newer Housing Precincts and Key Towns
what_it_is: Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme's Improvements for Residents in Newer Housing Precincts and Key Towns

sections.label: Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme for Keat Hong
sections.summary: The $900 million Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme serves precincts far from town centres and MRT stations, with Keat Hong residents served by eight bus services and Keat Hong LRT station.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) how will the $900 million Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme improve public bus connectivity for residents in newer housing precincts along Keat Hong Close, Choa Chu Kang Avenue 7 and Keat Hong Link; and (b) whether direct bus connectivity will be provided to key towns such as Teck Whye and Jurong East Central in particular.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: And the raison d'etre of the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP) is to serve precincts which are further away from town centres and Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Residents living along Keat Hong Close, Choa Chu Kang Avenue 7 and Keat Hong Link are currently served by eight bus services and Keat Hong Light Rail Transit (LRT) station, providing connectivity to major transport nodes and key amenities.

sections.label: Bus services for Brickland residents
sections.summary: Service 983M was introduced in March 2024 to connect to Teck Whye Crescent schools, and service 188 gives Brickland residents direct access to Jurong East Central.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: More recently, supplementary service 983M was introduced in March 2024 to provide a direct connection to the cluster of schools at Teck Whye Crescent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Brickland residents also have direct access to Jurong East Central by taking service 188.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To access amenities such as Choa Chu Kang Polyclinic and Teck Whye market, they can take services 172 or 991 to Choa Chu Kang Avenue 1 and continue with a short walk or transfer to service 307.

sections.label: Feedback on Keat Hong Close connectivity
sections.summary: Residents say Keat Hong Close connectivity can improve as it is a closed loop with only one bus service, and LTA will engage stakeholders to review bus services under the BCEP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: I have been receiving a lot of feedback from residents staying around Keat Hong Close.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: They feel that the connectivity can be improved upon because it is a closed loop and there is only one bus service that plies through Keat Hong Close.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In relation to Keat Hong Close, we are happy to work with him to see how we can improve connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: I would give him the assurance that LTA will engage community stakeholders to review the bus services under the BCEP, particularly when new precincts come up.
